t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mbi shereya, E Alla, ka don ko e de ye nda ko nki’don, ki’batu. N’tikɛra’ka ka’don ko se tɛ ne ye, setiki de ye e ye, fɛn ntɛ ne fɛ, fɛn tiki de ye e ye. Alla wɛrɛ shi’tɛ fo ekelen, E min bɛ se ka mɔgɔ dɛmɛn ka bɔ gɛlɛyala, E min ma da fɛn fɛ.
